GOAL: the SAME frozen experiment, the SAME draws, the SAME statistic, the SAME outputs — only less wall-clock

1_REFERENCE_IS_ORACLE.never: change the reference merely to accommodate speed
1_REFERENCE_IS_ORACLE.float_order_differences: do NOT invent a tolerance after seeing the result; a separate NUMERIC-CONTRACT AMENDMENT would be required first

2_RNG_FULLY_SEPARATED.invariant: 1 worker / 4 workers / 8 workers / different completion order / worker restart CANNOT change the experiment

3_PARALLELISM_ACROSS_DRAWS_ONLY.SCALE: 200 independent draw jobs -> parallel -> collect ALL -> assemble by canonical draw_id -> compute c_j, s_j ONCE
3_PARALLELISM_ACROSS_DRAWS_ONLY.NULL: 1800 independent jobs using the FROZEN c_j/s_j -> parallel
3_PARALLELISM_ACROSS_DRAWS_ONLY.HARD_ORDERING: NULL cannot start before SCALE aggregation is sealed
3_PARALLELISM_ACROSS_DRAWS_ONLY.rule: worker completion order NEVER determines aggregation order

4_POOL_DEDUP.rule: a pool's mapped Y is prepared ONCE per draw and reused by every claim sharing that evaluable universe
4_POOL_DEDUP.GUARD: POOL DEDUP MAY SHARE COMPUTATION — IT MAY NOT MERGE CLAIM IDENTITIES

5_EXACT_RANK_ARITHMETIC.fast_path: arrange each pool's Y ONCE per draw in canonical sorted order (y, row_id); tie-break deterministically by row_id
5_EXACT_RANK_ARITHMETIC.note: the internal order of equal Y values must not change the numerical median
5_EXACT_RANK_ARITHMETIC.method: RANK-SELECT on the positive mask and on its complement

MEDIAN_SEMANTICS.even_n: the EXACT reference average of the two central selected values

REQUIRED_FIXTURES: positive mask containing the first row
positive mask containing the last row

6_REFERENCE_KERNEL_RETAINED.FAST_KERNEL: pool dedup + rank-select + parallel draws, production candidate
6_REFERENCE_KERNEL_RETAINED.after_qualification: the reference code is RETAINED as a regression oracle, not deleted

7_FULL_50_DRAW_EQUIVALENCE.setup: identical synthetic payload and identical frozen map manifest, 20 SCALE + 30 NULL, 20,751 claims, BOTH kernels

architecture: REFERENCE statistic kernel OR FAST statistic kernel
8_SHARED_UPSTREAM_LAYER.rule: the fast kernel MUST NOT re-implement active_window, the time-local cyclic map, EARLY_CLOSE identity or availability atomicity in a second formula
8_SHARED_UPSTREAM_LAYER.both_kernels: receive the SAME mapped pool arrays and masks wherever possible
8_SHARED_UPSTREAM_LAYER.rationale: this dramatically reduces the defect surface

9_STABILITY_SEMANTICS_UNCHANGED.rule: if FAST counts a claim defined and REFERENCE does not, or vice versa -> FAST FAIL

10_CI_FAST_KERNEL_SEPARATE.reference: w(s,d) = m_security(s) * m_date(d); theta* = weighted_median(Y|positive) - weighted_median(Y|evaluable non-positive)
10_CI_FAST_KERNEL_SEPARATE.fast_may: reuse the sorted pool order, since bootstrap changes only the WEIGHTS, not Y
10_CI_FAST_KERNEL_SEPARATE.requirement: pin the reference weighted-median primitive with a machine-readable fixture BEFORE optimising

11_PROCESS_ARCHITECTURE.platform_note: macOS — use PROCESSES, not one large shared DuckDB write job
WORKER: writes ONE result shard per draw
AGGREGATOR: verifies every expected draw ID appears EXACTLY ONCE
11_PROCESS_ARCHITECTURE.thread_pinning: worker-level BLAS/OpenMP thread count = 1, to avoid 8 processes x hidden 8 threads oversubscription

12_CRASH_RESTART.principle: a crash is an EXECUTION event, never a STATISTICAL event

13_BENCHMARK_PRESPECIFIED.protocol: the same fixed 10 or 20 representative smoke draws
13_BENCHMARK_PRESPECIFIED.production_choice: highest tested throughput WITH zero swap thrash, zero correctness mismatch, stable memory
13_BENCHMARK_PRESPECIFIED.explicit: if 8 workers are slower than 4, choose 4. This is a PERFORMANCE decision and does not touch the statistic.
13_BENCHMARK_PRESPECIFIED.forbidden: choosing the worker count from one cherry-picked fastest run after seeing results

14_ARTIFACT_SPLIT.then: MASSIVE_NEW_FAMILY_EXACT_FAST_KERNEL_QUALIFICATION_V1 — 50/50 draw equivalence, 20,751/20,751 claims, 0 mismatches, CI smoke 20 draws 0 mismatches, negative fixtures fail-before-fix/pass-after-fix, deterministic replay PASS -> STATUS = EXACT_FAST_KERNEL_QUALIFIED
14_ARTIFACT_SPLIT.and: MASSIVE_NEW_FAMILY_FAST_KERNEL_FEASIBILITY_V1 — throughput and chosen worker count, carrying NO evidentiary status

15_NO_REAL_Y_DURING_OPTIMISATION.why: if the optimised kernel's correctness were first learned on real Y, the implementation choice would be made AFTER outcome exposure — already too late

CORRECTNESS_SIGNAL_GUARD.rule: the time-local smoke's p_adj_min 0.323 vs the superseded global 0.677 MUST NOT be used as a correctness signal for the fast kernel
CORRECTNESS_SIGNAL_GUARD.not_authority: resemblance of a final summary statistic
